text:
mira: Heads up — product wants a new 'amortized savings' panel in the cost dashboard that shows per-model effective token cost after cache credits and routing overrides. Goal: make it clear which routes are actually saving money vs just shifting load. thoughts?

devon: +1. We need to define the numerator/denominator first. Is this: (raw GPU token cost - cache credits) / served_tokens ? or do we amortize prefix cache costs across tenants?

alex: I think we need two metrics: marginal token cost (exclude fixed prefix cache priming amortized separately) and amortized total cost (includes priming + KV writes). Marginal helps routing decisions, amortized helps billing/chargeback.

sam: Quick numbers from last week (canary): model=v1-large, total_tokens=12.3M, gpu_cost=$246, cache_savings=$82 -> amortized_cost_per_k = (246-82)/12.3M*1000 ~= $0.0133 per k.

nate: UI constraints: console widgets can't do arbitrary joins across high-cardinality keys. We should pre-agg by (model, route_policy, day) and expose toggles: window (1d/7d/30d), aggregation (median/mean/95p).

mira: @devon can you sketch the data pipeline? we need an event->agg->panel flow, and a toggle to show with/without cache credits. Also want a little explainer copy for PMs.

devon: Sketch: ingest token events (model, tenant, route, tokens, cache_hit), enrich with cost_profile (model unit rates, routing overrides), emit daily rollups: total_tokens, gpu_cost_est, cache_credit_est, priming_cost, requests. Then panel computes strings and sparkline. Example SQL for the rollup: ```SELECT model, route_policy, date_trunc('day', ts) as day, sum(tokens) as total_tokens, sum(gpu_cost) as gpu_cost, sum(cache_credit) as cache_credit, sum(priming_cost) as priming FROM cost_rollups GROUP BY 1,2,3;```

.olivia: telemetry note: storing token-level events for all tenants will explode cardinality. We should keep full retention for a sampled subset and store deterministic rollups for everyone. Sampling must be consistent per-tenant to avoid noisy A/B.

alex: For routing we need marginal cost hooks in the router: it needs per-request marginal_cost_estimate (fast lookup) to decide fallback. That means precompute marginal_cost_by_model_windowed. Router can fetch cache hit ratio and subtract expected savings. Keep the lookup in redis keyed by model:route:window.

sam: Visualization suggestion: a small table with columns [model, route_policy, amortized_per_k, marginal_per_k, cache_savings_pct, sparkline(30d)] and a row-expander with sample queries. Also add an 'anomaly' flag if amortized rises >25% week-over-week.

mira: rollout plan: start as an internal-only beta in console for infra+cost teams. If numbers look stable, expose to customers with opt-in. Need doc strings for how we compute amortized vs marginal and a 'how to read' modal.

devon: action items: 1) infra: add rollup job (daily) that emits model+route aggregates (devon). 2) analytics: validate sampling + a small run to compute variance (sam). 3) router: implement fast marginal lookup (alex). 4) console: prototype panel with toggles (nate). 5) ops: watch telemetry cardinality after rollout (olivia).

mira: timeline suggestion: prototype + sample run in 2 weeks, beta internal in 4. Anyone blocked?

olivia: blocked on storage budget estimate — I'll compute and share. Also please add deploy-bot to rollup job workspace so we get deploy messages. :eyes:

deploy-bot: rolled out cost-rollup-job v0.2 to staging at 1919991120 :rocket:

nate: UX note — make the default view 'amortized' since finance asks for that first, but add a clear switch to 'marginal' for routing teams. Keep CSV export.

mira: ok thanks all — I'll make a tiny spec and attach to the PR. Adding checklist to the thread. :thumbsup:
